name: podbenchmark
description: Compare print-on-demand (POD) suppliers including Printify, Printful, Gelato, Prodigi, CustomCat, Fourthwall, Inkthreadable, Apliiq, Artelo and merchOne. Find which supplier costs less for T-shirts, hoodies and mugs by comparing product prices, shipping costs, total delivered cost and delivery estimates for your customers' country.
